energy_conservation.name: Energy Conservation
energy_conservation.notes: In a closed system, total mechanical energy is conserved. KE + PE = constant.

connections.notes: As an object rises, KE converts to PE
As an object falls, PE converts to KE

work_energy_theorem.name: Work-Energy Theorem
work_energy_theorem.notes: Net work done on an object equals change in kinetic energy.

connections.notes: Force applied over distance produces work

power_work_relation.name: Power-Work Relation
power_work_relation.notes: Power is the rate at which work is done.

connections.notes: Power is work per unit time

impulse_momentum.name: Impulse-Momentum
impulse_momentum.notes: Impulse equals change in momentum. Force × time = Δp

connections.notes: Force applied over time changes momentum

newtons_laws.name: Newton's Laws of Motion
newtons_laws.notes: Fundamental relationships between force, mass, and motion.

connections.notes: F = dp/dt (force is rate of change of momentum)
